description.value: Bighorn Meadows Resort is a luxury condo-suite resort managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, set on a 9-acre property surrounded on three sides by the Springs Golf Course in Radium Hot Springs. Located in the Columbia Valley between the Rocky and Purcell Mountain ranges, it sits within easy reach of Kootenay National Park and the famous Radium Hot Springs mineral pools. The resort offers a range of suite styles including loft and townhome configurations, along with hot tubs and a seasonal outdoor pool.

address.value: #10 Bighorn Boulevard, Radium Hot Springs, BC, V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the resort is a real, operating luxury property at #10 Bighorn Boulevard, Radium Hot Springs, BC, with phone and address matching OSM exactly. Complimentary Wi-Fi is explicitly stated on the front page ('Stay connected with our complimentary Wi-Fi'). No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null. The FAQ subpage contains text referencing 'Harrison Hot Springs Hotel' which appears to be a CMS template bleed-over from another True Key portfolio property.
concerns: FAQ subpage contains room descriptions referencing 'Harrison Hot Springs Hotel' — appears to be a CMS template bleed-over from another True Key Hotels & Resorts property; does not affect the validity of this listing.
Website shows postal code as 'V0A 1MO' (letter O) rather than the correct Canadian format 'V0A 1M0' (zero); likely a typographical error on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating luxury resort in Radium Hot Springs with an active booking system and confirmed contact details. A clear and useful accommodation option for touring cyclists in the Columbia Valley.
